decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on a proven trommel platform at the heart of the firm's mobile screening business, so it costs little to keep, although its absence from the website since 2020 points to some risk.
The mobile high-speed grinder line fits the core mobile business and is still a plausible option, but the lack of visible results since 2020 raises doubt about its value.
The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C and has shown no evidence of value since launch, so consolidating it frees resources for the established business.
The stationary pre-shredder line supports the move toward plant solutions and keeping it open costs little, though its absence from the website since 2020 signals uncertainty after restructuring.
